customManagers.description: Lightwell remediated: treat the upstream version as the compatibility key and only move between its +rhlw rebuilds (3.1.5 -> 3.1.5+rhlw.1 -> 3.1.5+rhlw.2, never 3.1.6). The Python twin of the java-remediated preset in lightwell-experience/renovate-config.

packageRules.description: Look up packages on the offline Nexus (the same index as pip.conf) instead of packages.redhat.com
Label and word Lightwell remediation PRs
prBodyNotes: **Red Hat Lightwell remediation.** `{{{depName}}} {{{newVersion}}}` is Red Hat's rebuild of the upstream `{{{currentValue}}}` release with security fixes backported. The upstream version doesn't change, so there's no feature upgrade to re-certify. The CVEs it fixes are published as `RHLW-*` OSV records in the `Red Hat Lightwell:PyPI` ecosystem: https://osv.dev/list?ecosystem=Red+Hat+Lightwell%3APyPI&q={{{depName}}}
